title: Non-autonomous KAM theory for lower dimensional invariant tori (I): Normally elliptic and hyperbolic cases
summary: Many physical phenomena are naturally modeled by dynamical systems subject to non-autonomous perturbations that decay in time, including the interaction of a laser pulse with a molecule, epidemiological models, nonlinear oscillatory systems, and celestial mechanics. In the present paper, we consider time-dependent perturbations decaying in time of Hamiltonian systems having a lower-dimensional isotropic normally elliptic (resp. hyperbolic) invariant torus with quasiperiodic solutions.
